lessons: Evidence is still thin for almost all change kinds (such as home wait_info, sign_in reorder, and finish redesign) because each has only been tested once.
With 2 tests completed for adoption copy changes, results do not agree (one won at +4.5% after noise correction, while the other showed no clear effect at -0.3%), so evidence remains thin.
